name: algolia
description: Algolia search and index management powered by the official algolia/mcp server — run queries, list indices, read and update index settings, batch upsert/delete records, manage A/B tests, inspect analytics, configure query suggestions, recommendations, and federated collections, and read usage metrics.

interface.shortDescription: Query, configure, and manage Algolia indexes through the official algolia/mcp server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent has a direct line to your Algolia search engine — it can run searches, tweak ranking settings, add or update records, check analytics, and run A/B tests on your search experience. From tuning which fields are searchable to checking how many queries are coming in, everything happens through natural conversation. No more digging through the Algolia dashboard for every little change.
defaultPrompt: Show me what indices I have and how my search is performing.
Help me tune my search settings to get better results.
Check if there are any issues with my Algolia configuration.
